morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语中作为完整借词使用，不拆成马来语前缀 mas- 与词根 jid。j 表示 /d͡ʒ/；输入包所列语音变体 [ˈmas.d͡ʒit̪̚] 中，词尾 d 清化且不完全释放。

senses.zh_definition: 清真寺；穆斯林举行主麻聚礼及其他宗教礼拜活动的专用建筑。
senses.en_definition: A mosque: a building designated for Muslim Friday congregational prayers and other acts of worship.
senses.ms_definition: Bangunan khas tempat umat Islam melakukan solat Jumaat dan ibadah-ibadah lain.
senses.nuances: 这是输入包所引《Kamus Dewan》第四版释义。与 surau 不宜一概互换：surau 通常指较小的礼拜场所，而具体用途及主麻聚礼安排须视当地情况。masjid 作普通名词时小写，作为专名组成部分时大写，如 Masjid Negara。

collocations.zh: 积极开展清真寺的礼拜与社群活动
collocations.en: keep the mosque active through worship and community activities

dual_scenarios.context: 社区公告 / 公益活动
dual_scenarios.ms: Jawatankuasa masjid akan mengadakan program agihan makanan kepada penduduk yang memerlukan pada hari Sabtu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 清真寺委员会将于星期六向有需要的居民派发食物。
dual_scenarios.en: The mosque committee will hold a food distribution programme for residents in need on Saturday.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku dah sampai kat masjid. Jumpa kat pintu pagar je, ya.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya sudah tiba di masjid. Kita berjumpa di pintu pagar sahaja, ya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我已经到清真寺了。就在大门口见吧。
dual_scenarios.en: I'm at the mosque now. Let's meet at the gate, okay?
spoken_features: aku：熟人间使用的第一人称代词
kat：此处对应处所介词 di
ya：缓和语气并寻求对方认同

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah sampai kat masjid. Kau kat mana?
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah tiba di masjid. Kamu berada di mana?
messages.zh: 我已经到清真寺了。你在哪里？
messages.en: I'm at the mosque now. Where are you?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku baru nak sampai. Tunggu kat pintu pagar je, ya.
messages.ms_standard: Saya hampir tiba. Tunggu di pintu pagar sahaja, ya.
messages.zh: 我快到了。你就在大门口等一下吧。
messages.en: I'm almost there. Just wait at the gate, okay?

etymology.historical_story: Masjid comes from Arabic, where it denotes a place of prostration and belongs to the root s-j-d, associated with prostrating in worship. Malay borrowed the whole word rather than its Arabic grammatical structure. Its Jawi spelling preserves the Arabic consonants, connecting the written form directly with the religious vocabulary of its source language. See [Quranic Arabic Corpus: masjid morphology](https://corpus.quran.com/wordmorphology.jsp?location=%282%3A144%3A13%29).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 masjid 与 sujud（叩拜）联想：两者的阿拉伯语来源共享 s-j-d 词根，清真寺就是礼拜叩拜的地方。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈及清真寺及礼拜活动时应保持尊重。进入礼拜区域时轻声交谈、保持整洁，并遵从现场关于衣着、鞋履和活动区域的指示。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 可用于宗教、建筑及社区活动语境。访客应先确认开放安排；拍摄会众或进入特定区域前征询许可，避免打扰正在礼拜的人。
